examples.text: [Headline:] „Historian berates billionaires at Davos over tax avoidance“

examples.text: „[…] Trump was basically berating them, saying, I just need to have 11,780 more votes because that will make me win in Georgia.“

examples.text: „The video shows two patrol officers […] berating a 5-year-old boy after he left the grounds of East Silver Spring Elementary School in January 2020.“
